title: Rav Huna son of Rav Chiyya
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Avodah Zarah 67b, but Hyman says the reading there should be “Chiyya son of Rav Huna,” as in Dikdukei Soferim; and so it is in Pesachim 44b.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Avodah Zarah 67b paragraph names Rav Huna son of Rav Chiyya, whereas the whole Pesachim 44b paragraph names Rav Chiyya son of Rav Huna. Hyman’s “should read” emendation and Dikdukei Soferim report retain their force and attribution. The two literal directions remain distinct; no fresh apparatus collation or father-son harmonization is admitted.
